title: ActionEvidencePayload
description: The decoded payload of an action evidence reference (format trooth.action-evidence.v1): the short-lived object api.trooth.co signs when a workspace's agent is authorized for one action under a delegation. It travels as an Ed25519 compact JWS with the header {"alg":"EdDSA","typ":"trooth-action-evidence+jwt","kid":"trooth-evidence-2026-10"}, the payload being these members as canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces), signed with the key /public/keys publishes with purpose signed-references. It is evidence beside a payment partner's mandate: it does not move money and does not say a payment will be made. docs/ACTION-EVIDENCE.md; built by issueInner in trooth-os-worker-f src/action-authz.ts.

iat.description: When Trooth issued the reference, in seconds since the epoch.

exp.description: When the reference expires, in seconds since the epoch: iat + 600.

jti.description: The reference's single-use id. Its public state is at https://api.trooth.co/public/action-evidence/<jti>.

authorization_id.description: The id of the action authorization the reference was issued for.

authorization_details.description: The one action, as an OAuth Rich Authorization Requests (RFC 9396) authorization_details object.

binding.description: The payment partner's mandate the reference is bound to.

principal.description: The workspace and the person whose delegation this is.

delegation.description: The delegation the action was checked against.

approval.description: How the delegation, and when it needed one, the action were approved.

counterparty.description: The counterparty and Trooth's latest signed reading of its public record.

responsibility.description: The written responsibility boundary: what Trooth observed, what the buyer approved, what the vendor represents and what is not established.

detail.title: ActionEvidenceDetail
detail.description: One authorization_details object: a payment or a data share.

payment.title: ActionEvidencePayment
payment.description: A payment to the counterparty, at or under the delegation's limit and in its currency.

locations.description: https URLs on the counterparty's domain (or a subdomain) where the action is taken.

creditorName.description: The payee's name, as the agent gave it.

description.description: What the payment is for, as the agent gave it.

dataShare.title: ActionEvidenceDataShare
dataShare.description: Sharing data of one class with the counterparty, at or under the delegation's data class.

locations.description: https URLs on the counterparty's domain (or a subdomain) where the data is sent.

description.description: What is shared, as the agent gave it.

amount.title: ActionEvidenceAmount
amount.description: A decimal amount with at most two fraction digits, and an ISO 4217 currency code.
The amount as a decimal string, at most two fraction digits.

dataClass.title: ActionDataClass
dataClass.description: A data class, from least to most sensitive.

actionType.title: ActionType
actionType.description: An action a delegation can permit.

binding.title: ActionEvidenceBinding
binding.description: The mandate the reference is bound to: one authorization per delegation, protocol and reference.

protocol.description: The payment protocol of the mandate.

reference_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the protocol, a newline and the mandate's reference.

principal.title: ActionPrincipal
principal.description: The workspace and the person who delegated.

user.description: The id of the person in the workspace.

agentKey.title: ActionAgentKey
agentKey.description: The agent's DPoP key, by thumbprint.

jkt.description: The RFC 7638 JWK thumbprint (base64url SHA-256) of the agent's DPoP key.

delegation.title: ActionEvidenceDelegation
delegation.description: The delegation the action was checked against.

sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the delegation document's canonical JSON: the digest its delegation receipt names.

agent.description: The agent the delegation is to.

role.description: The role the agent acts in, as the person wrote it.

limit.description: The payment limit, or null for a delegation that does not pay.

data_class.description: The highest data class it may share, or null.

approval.title: ActionApprovalRecord
approval.description: How a person approved: who, when, and through which sign-in.

approved_by.description: The id of the person who approved.

method.description: identity_provider: a sign-in through the workspace's identity provider within five minutes; session_reauth: a fresh sign-in within fifteen.

acr.description: The authentication context class matching method.

idp.description: The identity provider, or null for a fresh sign-in without one.

idp.title: ActionApprovalIdp
idp.description: The identity provider a person signed in through.

domain.description: The provider's domain for the workspace.

approvals.title: ActionEvidenceApprovals
approvals.description: The approval of the delegation and, above its approval threshold, of the action.

action.description: How this action was approved, or null when it was at or under the approval threshold.

reading.title: ActionCounterpartyReading
reading.description: Trooth's latest signed reading of the counterparty's public record, or that it could not be read.

status.description: read, or not_read: then nothing about the counterparty is attested.

read_at.description: When the reading was taken (RFC 3339), when the record says.

log_index.description: The reading's index in Trooth's log, or null.

statement_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the public record answer read.

domain.description: The counterparty's domain: the delegation's target.

reading.description: Trooth's latest signed reading of its public record.

responsibility.title: ActionResponsibilityBoundary
responsibility.description: Who stands behind what, in plain sentences.

version.description: The boundary text's version, e.g. trooth.responsibility-boundary.v1-draft.

vendor_represented.description: What the counterparty represents about itself.

not_established.description: What the reference does not establish.

kid.description: The kid of the key that signed it; the same as the JWS header's.
